dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Pronounced concave spline along the trailing edge, exhibiting a deep inward curvature from the dorsal ridge to the sub-apex region.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex morphology with a small, distinct V-shaped notch at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin with a continuous convex curve, approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Terminal notch at the fin apex; secondary irregular indentation and ragged texture at the posterior basal insertion point. Extensive distribution of small, white punctate spots across the lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, uniform distribution of light-colored speckling across the entire visible dark epidermal surface of the dorsal fin.
